_metadata.description: Lifestyle Dashboard requirement registry - Parent-level requirements reference child modules declared under imports

requirements.title: Shared event schema and time-series storage
requirements.description: PostgreSQL time-series events table with JSONB payloads, common envelope (timestamp, domain, event_type, payload), indexed by domain+timestamp, extensible without migrations.

requirements.title: Domain registration and discovery
requirements.description: Dynamic domain scenario registration, capability exposure, health status tracking. Domains can start/stop independently.

requirements.title: Cross-domain query API
requirements.description: API endpoints for querying events across domains with time-range filters, domain filters, basic aggregations, and correlation queries.

requirements.title: Unified dashboard UI
requirements.description: Timeline view across all domains, per-domain sections with deep-dive links, trend charts, responsive design for mobile.

requirements.title: Daily brief system
requirements.description: Morning brief (what to do today) and evening review (what happened, notable patterns) consolidated from all active domains.

requirements.title: Correlation engine
requirements.description: Automated statistical correlation analysis across domains with significance tracking and configurable minimum data threshold.

requirements.title: Experiment framework
requirements.description: N=1 experiments with hypothesis, intervention, measurement, duration, compliance tracking, and outcome reports.
